Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

CLAMP BUTTONS TO BE USED WITH 

PARALLEL SIDED CLAMP PLATES 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for clamp buttons to be used with parallel 
sided clamp plates according to IS : 5252-1969 'Dimensions for wide clamp plates' and IS : 5998-1971 
'Specification for parallel sided clamp plates'.

3. Material — The clamp buttons shall be made from any of the following materials: 

a) Nylon — Suitable grade of nylon, hard quality, having shore hardness 49 to 65 when measured 
by Type D Durometer after 30 seconds. 



Adopted 14 March 1983

18:10574-1983 

b) Brass — Leaded brass conforming to Type 1 of IS : 319-1974 'Free-cutting brass bars, rods 
and sections ( th/rd revision)'. 

c) Sree/ — Free-cutting steel conforming to 15:4431-1978 'Carbon and carbon-manganese 
free-cutting steel (//rsf /-em/on)', medium carbon steel or alloy steel hardened to a surface 
hardness of 600 HV Mm. 

4. Designation — A clamp button having £) == 8 mm and / = 6 mm made of nylon shall be designated 
as: 

CLAMP BUTTON 8 X 6 — Nylon IS : 10574 

5. Finish — The clamp buttons shall be free from cracks, burrs and other defects. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to steel clamp buttons. 

6.2 Clamp buttons shall be packed in suitable cartons so as to prevent damage during transit. 

7. Marking 

7.1 The carton containing the clamp buttons shall be marked with designation and manufacturer's 
name or trade-mark. 

7.2 /S/ Certification Marking— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

For preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from BS : 5078-1974 'Specification 
for jig and fixture components' issued by the British Standards Institution ( BSI ). 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi. India
